paragraphs.text: Welcome back to Knicks Nation, everybody. Today we are going deep on the entire offseason, move by move, and what it actually means for this roster heading into the new season. There is a lot to get through, so grab a coffee, settle in, and let's talk some basketball.
card_lines: What it means for the rotation

paragraphs.text: The front office had three clear priorities this summer. Depth behind the starters, shooting on the wings, and keeping the core together without blowing past the second apron. How did they do? That is exactly what we are breaking down today.

Let's start with the starting five, because on paper this is one of the deepest opening units in the Eastern Conference. The questions are not about talent. They are about fit, health, and whether the bench can hold leads in the minutes that matter.
card_lines: Bench minutes are the swing factor

paragraphs.text: And that brings us to the biggest storyline of the year. If this team wants to get out of the East, the margin for error is razor thin. Every rotation decision in October is going to echo in May. That is the stakes for this season.
